tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Fetch the clean Markdown representation of a granite.ie page (its build-time .md twin). Accepts a full URL or a path.

url.description: A granite.ie page URL or path (e.g. 'https://www.granite.ie/case-studies/foo/' or '/specialisms/').

tools.name: get_specialism
tools.description: Get one Granite specialism by slug: title, summary, description, the services it groups, and public URL.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: List the industries/sectors Granite has published sector-specific experience for, with slug and public URL.

tools.name: list_specialisms
tools.description: List Granite's published specialisms (services offered), with slug, summary, and public URL. Use get_specialism for detail on one.

tools.name: search_case_studies
tools.description: Search Granite's published client case studies by keyword and/or sector. Returns title, summary, sectors, and public URL.

query.description: Free-text search across case study titles and content.

sector.description: Filter to a sector/industry, matched against the case study's categories (name or slug, case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of case studies to return (default 10).

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search Granite's published news articles and insights by keyword. Returns title, summary, categories, date, and public URL.

query.description: Free-text search across news article titles and content.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return (default 10).
